restaurant_name: คลินิกบ้านฟันสวย dental mind by dr.kai
text:
Honest dental clinic with reasonable prices.
I had a small chip and was enroute home to my dentist and stopped to see if it needed immediate fixing.

The dentist fluent in English inspected the tooth and we decided that I could wait 2 days until I returned home, as it might need a crown which takes 2-3 weeks.

They didnt even charge me for the 5 minute assessment. If I lived in Phuket, I'd be very confident using this clinic.

Nice, professional office.
Car parking can be a bit tight though.
